text:
nina: Quick reminder: multi-vendor sync with Nvidia/AMD/Habana at 10:00am PT tomorrow. Goals: thermal headroom policy, APAC power derates, SI harness checklist, and marketplace tagging.

harold: I'll bring rack-level thermal logs + suggested derates for dense configs. Short bullets only.

jin: kernel note: 2.0.5 shows a memory leak on MI300 at seq>4096 in our silicon runs. Recommend GA images with 2.0.3 unless partners insist on newer kernel.

olga: legal needs final SKU names and approved marketing assets at least 72h before any partner press. Also flagged export-control for select MI300 configs  sending restricted-list.

sam: ops asks to cap simultaneous deployments per-rack to 100 jobs; propose an auto-scale-down trigger when inlet temp > 30C.

nina: tiny runbook excerpt for the sync:
- rollout_windows: NA:2026-10-25..2026-11-05, EU:2026-10-27..2026-11-08, APAC:2026-10-29..2026-11-12
- announce_slot: 2026-11-12T17:00Z
- power_caps_watts: H100:340, H200:325, B200:275, MI300:440, Gaudi:205
- fallback_order: H100_int8 -> H200_fp16 -> Gaudi_fp16 -> MI300
- max_jobs_per_rack: 100 (soft cap)

announce-bot: action required: create branch "vendor-onramp-2026-hw" once /releases/hw/sku.csv is uploaded. :robot_face:

jin: will export SI CSV (model,kernel,quant,target_hw,notes) and attach to notes. keeping file compact for partner consumption.

harold: proposing APAC derate: +15% thermal padding for SEA racks, +8% for JPN racks.

nina: partners asked for 72h embargo for strategic partners; ops prefers 48h default. Olga?

olga: confirmed: default embargo = 48h. For named strategic partners we can extend to 72h after image & SKU vetting, and approved spokespeople.

nina: please upload final SKU list by Tue COB. Meeting doc: https://go/repo/partnerships/hw-sync. Bring any final perf traces to the top of the call. :thumbsup:
